message: I'd like a T75 Row-Crop with delivery and setup. I can pay in full today. Would you do $56,000 total including delivery?

Thanks for the offer, and I appreciate that you're ready to pay in full today. $56,000 is too far below what we can do on the T75 with delivery. The list price for that package is $68,900. Since you're ready to buy today, I can offer $66,500 total for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough. That gets you the 75 hp 4WD with the enclosed A/C cab, ready to work when it arrives.
Heartland posts the T75 at $65,950 and delivery at $875. I need to be well under that to switch. I can do $60,000 total with delivery, paid today.

I appreciate the straightforward offer and the full payment today. I can't verify Heartland's pricing on my end, but I want to earn your business. $60,000 is lower than I can go on this package. I can come down to $63,250 total for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a full walkthrough. That's $5,650 under our list price for the package, and the machine shows up ready to work.
Meet me at $61,500 total with delivery and I'll check out right now.

We're close, and I'd like to get this done today. I can meet you partway at $62,250 total for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough. If that works, you can check out right now.
Deal. $61,800 total for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough. Thanks for your business. You can check out now with the offer id provided.
